title: Initial Search Invariant
statement: For every bit string $z$, there exist natural numbers $c,d$ and a bit $b$ such that the initial state for input $z$ encodes $c,d,b$, with $2^{\lceil\log_2(2|z|)\rceil}<c\leq q$, $2\leq d\leq c$, and no integer $m$ with $2\leq m<d$ divides $c$. Here $q$ is the least prime greater than $2^{\lceil\log_2(2|z|)\rceil}$. The bit $b$ can be true only when $c=q$.
hypotheses_covered: z is an arbitrary bit string
